data.action: 双臂抱胸神情冷静肃穆，背后晶体结构巨兽 Mon3tr 破体而出发出震天咆哮，绿色源石晶体散发耀眼荧光
data.camera: cowboy shot, commanding stance with Mon3tr in midground
data.description: 【凯尔希 · Mon3tr 身侧】被夜幕笼罩的罗德岛外甲板上，巨大的结晶生物 Mon3tr 静默地盘踞在她的身后，猩红的脊柱晶体散发出威慑的光芒。凯尔希负手而立，衣袂在荒原冷风中猎猎作响——「大地在低语，古老的阴影从未真正散去。但在那之前，罗德岛这艘船……依然会航行在正确的航道上。」
data.lighting: 夜幕下的昏黄残光与 Mon3tr 幽绿源石荧光形成极度强烈的冷暖对冲光影
data.location: 泰拉切尔诺伯格废墟荒原
data.promptProse: Kal'tsit stands arms crossed on Rhodes Island's outer deck while crystalline Mon3tr roars behind her in the midground. Grey tactical jacket, black work vest and cargo trousers retain the outfit beneath her side ponytail and calm commanding gaze. The cowboy view follows deck structures into night. Yellow residual deck light warms her nearer sleeve; Mon3tr's green Originium crystals illuminate its angular body and reflect along her opposite jacket edge in the cold wind.
data.title: 凯尔希 · Mon3tr 降临·荒原上的冷酷指令
